caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame with four tall, ornately turned posts at each corner, each topped with a rounded finial. The main color of the bed frame is a light brown wood tone, with some darker shading to suggest wood grain and three-dimensionality. The headboard is composed of a solid wooden plank with a decorative, curving upper edge and two horizontal rails, while the footboard has an upper horizontal bar with turned detailing and another horizontal element beneath it. The bed frame includes side rails and cross supports for slats, with notches indicating where slats may be placed. There is an additional, smaller inset diagram in the lower left corner that provides a side view of the bed showing the height of 52 inches and the scale used for the drawing (¼ inch to 1 inch). The background of the image is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Bishop Hill: Bed
